get_paths_from_recording_folder: use Hot3dDataPathProvider.fromRecordingFolder to get headset-specific path objects from a recording folder
check_quest3_sequence_validity: use Quest3DatasetPaths.is_valid to verify all required Quest3 sequence files exist on disk
check_aria_sequence_validity: use AriaDatasetPaths.is_valid to verify all required Aria sequence files exist on disk
get_quest3_required_filepaths: use Quest3DatasetPaths.required_filepaths to list all required file paths for a Quest3 recording
get_aria_mps_folderpath: use AriaDatasetPaths.mps_folderpath to get the MPS folder path for an Aria recording
